info.title: About WoWControlSDK
info.whatDescription: WoWControlSDK is a lightweight injected DLL that exposes internal methods of World of Warcraft 3.3.5a through a clean JSON-RPC 2.0 interface over Windows Named Pipes. It allows launchers, overlays and tools to interact with the game without modifying the client.
info.howDescription: The SDK injects WoWControlSDK.dll into Wow.exe via WowInjector.exe and communicates through a named pipe. The launcher sends JSON-RPC calls for Lua execution, unit queries, world state and more, receiving typed responses securely in JSON format.
info.forWhatDescription: The launcher needs this DLL to interact with the client and display a rich presence: your current zone, level, whether you are dead, your class and race, whether you are on the login screen, a loading screen and more. It also allows the launcher, through events emitted by the DLL, to send notifications when someone whispers you, when a dungeon pops while you are not focused on the World of Warcraft window, and many more features. It is open source, so you can review its code at will, modify it or create your own versions.

audit.summary: {count} addons can move your items or gold without telling you
audit.summaryDescription: The check found code that deletes items, hands over gold or confirms dialogs for you. Check that they only do it when you ask.
audit.disclaimer: The check looks for known patterns in the addon code. Many of them have legitimate uses, and it cannot guarantee that an addon is safe: install addons only from sources you trust.

delete_items.title: Deletes items
delete_items.description: Calls DeleteCursorItem, which destroys the item on your cursor. It is fine in options such as "delete gray items" that you turn on; it is dangerous if it happens without you asking.

send_gold.title: Sends gold by mail
send_gold.description: Puts gold in a mail (SetSendMailMoney). Mail addons use it when you type the amount; an addon doing it on its own can empty your gold.

give_gold.title: Hands over gold
give_gold.description: Picks up your gold or adds it to a trade (PickupPlayerMoney, AddTradeMoney). It is rarely needed outside an action of yours.

guild_bank_withdraw.title: Withdraws guild bank gold
guild_bank_withdraw.description: Takes gold from the guild bank (WithdrawGuildBankMoney). Check that it only happens when you ask.

auto_confirm.title: Confirms dialogs for you
auto_confirm.description: Clicks the accept button of a confirmation window or answers the delete item dialog. This can skip the confirmations that protect your items.

guild_control.title: Manages the guild
guild_control.description: Removes, demotes, changes the leader of or disbands the guild. It is normal in commands such as /gkick; check that it does not act on its own.

accept_trade.title: Accepts trades
accept_trade.description: Clicks accept in the trade window. Some addons use it to speed up trades you check.

send_mail.title: Sends mail
send_mail.description: Sends mail. It is expected in mail addons; check who it sends to and what if you do not use one.

dynamic_code.title: Runs generated code
dynamic_code.description: Creates and runs code while the game runs (loadstring or RunScript). It is common in libraries such as Ace3 and in WeakAuras.

remote_code.title: Runs code received from other players
remote_code.description: Runs code created while the game runs in a file that also receives messages from other players (addon messages or whispers). ElvUI shares profiles this way, but it is also how an addon can be controlled remotely.

logout.title: Logs out or quits the game
logout.description: Calls Logout or Quit. It is usually a button or an option of yours.

auction.title: Uses the auction house
auction.description: Posts items or bids. It is expected in auction addons.

environment.title: Changes function environments
environment.description: Uses setfenv to isolate or change the environment of other functions. Custom code systems use it.

obfuscated.title: Packed or obfuscated code
obfuscated.description: Contains encoded text or huge strings without spaces. Sometimes it is compressed data; it is also a way to hide what the code does.
